svg.title: Waveform from the stream simulation, the first frame of scenario 1 (12 words, six beats). The crc register starts at ffffffff and changes once per clock, through two chained CRC steps, a_crc after word A and b_crc after word B. On the last beat the second step produces the CRC word, the inverse of a_crc, b023c43c, and b_crc reloads ffffffff for the next frame.
svg.desc: Waveform from the stream simulation, the first frame of scenario 1 (12 words, six beats). The crc register starts at ffffffff and changes once per clock, through two chained CRC steps, a_crc after word A and b_crc after word B. On the last beat the second step produces the CRC word, the inverse of a_crc, b023c43c, and b_crc reloads ffffffff for the next frame.

g.text: The register holds ffffffff. Step A takes the header word, step B the sequence number.
Every clock the register takes b_crc: the result of step A and then step B, in one clock.
A takes the last payload word. B outputs ~a_crc, the CRC word, and b_crc reloads ffffffff.
TDATA[63:32] is b023c43c, the CRC word, next to payload word 00000007. The next frame starts.
